prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup. Edit Image 1, the existing ZANKII '02 LUNAR LIGHT' game concept board. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Image 2 is an exact SHAPE REFERENCE for the requested Geometry Dash Fat Wave / Wave 17 character (grayscale sprite). Preserve Image 1's serene navy starry night mood, moon, layered low-contrast polygon mountains, game HUD layout, generous open playable corridor, 16:10 landscape composition, understated thin lavender outlines, and bottom row of three level menu cards. Make only the following focused revisions.

1. Replace the thin arrow player in the main gameplay screen with the Fat Wave silhouette from Image 2. Precisely match its short broad nearly circular outer shell, round inner disk, angular chevron notch pointing right, and two small square tipped protrusions on the upper-right and lower-right. It is NOT a triangle, ship, fish, or generic ball: match the reference recognizable outline. Orient it about 45 degrees upward along the final rising segment of the trail. Primary color 1, the outer shell, is clean vivid BLUE #007DFF. Secondary color 2, the round inner disk and small inset details, is vivid VIOLET #7D00FF. Retain thin dark separations like the reference, optionally a narrow pale edge so it reads against navy. The player is only modestly larger visually than the old arrow; do not make it enormous. Thin straight-segment zigzag trail follows BEHIND the player only, soft blue with subtle violet outer glow, no sinusoidal curves, no looping or dotted trail. Keep instantaneous zigzag direction changes.

2. Evolve the foreground obstacle art modestly so ZANKII has its own identity while retaining a recognizable precision geometric Wave game. Keep the overall course layout and existing large angular platforms, but introduce clipped/chamfered corners, subtle inset panels and small violet edge joints. Replace around half the ordinary isosceles triangular spikes with compact asymmetrical faceted crystal shards and a few slim diamond-shaped hazards attached to the platforms. Preserve several classic triangular hazards, readable broad passages, clear solid collision silhouettes, and low visual clutter. This should be a restrained redesign, not a different genre or elaborate 3D scene. No floating mountains or ornaments that could be mistaken for collision objects. Background remains dim; hazards are readable pale lavender.

3. Bottom row: preserve the three existing menu card slots and level names 'FIRST FLIGHT', 'SOFT RHYTHM', 'AFTERGLOW', update their thumbnails with the new obstacle motifs and Fat Wave. Replace the original center palette-swatch panel and oversized '02 LUNAR LIGHT' footer with a tasteful compact character preview panel: enlarged Fat Wave correctly colored blue shell / violet disk, two small color swatches labeled exactly '1 BLUE' and '2 VIOLET', and a discreet 'LUNAR LIGHT' label. The enlarged icon must precisely match the same shape used in gameplay. Keep the whole design board consistent, quiet and polished. Preserve title ZANKII exactly. No annotations about source images, no watermark, no browser frame. This is an updated style concept, not proof of implemented physics.
